notes.title: Menu Please! - Update
notes.notes:
Hello, I hope you are having a nice day. I published a small update, if you want, I can share some information about it.

- Fixed the issue which causes the restaurant's status to change when the player closes the order panel using the close button. 

- Customer sitting time has been doubled. Customers will now be able to wait much longer for their orders.

That's all I've arranged for now. If you want to give me feedback, please share it with me under this heading or you can reach me via e-mail if you wish.

E-mail : gungor.works@gmail.com

Sincelery,
Musa GUNGOR

notes.title: Menu Please! - Released
notes.notes: Our game has been released, I hope it has been a production that meets your expectations. You can share your ideas, opinions and suggestions with me under this topic. You can access my game at a discounted price until January 27, 2022.

notes.title: Menu Please! - Release Date January 21, 2022
notes.notes:
First of all, if you are interested in my game, please don't forget to add it to your wishlist.

I would like to give some information about our game and share my experiences with you. Frankly, it was a game that was both challenging for me and I tried new things. This is the first time I have used such extensive systems. (Particals, effects, etc.). I hope I made a game that will meet your expectations. I would like to talk about the language options. There are 7 different language options in my game, but the translations may not be exactly what you want, because I don't know how to support words with special expressions (æ, é, à, etc.) in fonts. In a problem, instead of the exact meanings of various words, I had to choose short words with close meanings because I had to fit the text on the game screen. Therefore, the language options may not satisfy you much, I can understand this, but I did my best.

If you want me to give information about the gameplay part;

Host customers from 3 different levels.

At level 1, manage a dessert shop and bake delicious donuts and cupcakes.

At level 2, manage a small fastfood shop, serve delicious fries and drinks.

At level 3, manage a large restaurant, cook burgers, sandwiches, cookies, pizza and much more and prove that your restaurant is the best.

Honestly, level 3 is the most food you can cook, and preparing them is the most exhausting level. In order to cook various dishes, you have to make the necessary sub-materials and constantly check your stocks.

I think that's all the information I'm going to convey to you for now. Thank you for reading this far and taking your time. One last request from you, if you like my game, please don't forget to add it to your wish list.

Sincerely,
Musa GUNGOR
